verdict.rationale: Mailchimp's pricing page lists "Generative AI features" as a plan feature, and its homepage promotes "AI tools," which points to some first-party generative capability. Nothing in the pack says this AI drafts or refines subject lines or email copy from a brief inside the composer. The "create campaigns with the AI you already use" item describes an external chat assistant, not in-composer AI, and Analytics AI covers reporting, so neither is credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of AI subject-line generation, AI drafting of email body copy from a brief, refinement of existing copy, confirmation that this works inside the email composer, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
